convert_axisangle_to_rotation_matrix: convert an axis-angle vector to a 3x3 rotation matrix using axisangle_to_rmat
convert_rotation_matrix_to_axisangle: convert a 3x3 rotation matrix to an axis-angle vector using rmat_to_axisangle
multiply_quaternions: multiply two quaternions using quat_mul to compose rotations via the Hamiltonian product
convert_quaternion_to_homogeneous_matrix: convert a position and quaternion to a 4x4 homogeneous transform using pos_quat_to_hmat
convert_homogeneous_to_twist: extract the 6D exponential coordinates twist from a homogeneous transform using hmat_to_twist
